newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bank sells Brazil unit to Wachovia.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bank sells Brazil unit to Wachovia.

text.p: Banco Portugues do Atlantico, a unit of Banco Comercial Portugues, said Tuesday it had sold its Brazilian unit, BPA-Brasil, to a joint venture controlled by Wachovia Corp. of Winston-Salem, N.C.
The bank did not give the value of the deal.

The joint venture, WSH Holdings Ltd, was formed by Wachovia International Capital Corp., the international arm of Wachovia Corp., and Saenz Hofman International Ltd, a finance company based in Brazil.
Banco Portugues do Atlantico said in a statement that it expected the deal to be concluded in the first half of 1997, subject to the agreement of monetary authorities.
